responsibility: Serves as the master device catalog for the AMD GCN port, listing every supported GPU and generic architecture variant in a macro table consumed by both GCC and libgomp-related tooling. For each device it records the external -march name, processor macro name, ELF e_flags value, internal ISA family, default HSACO attributes such as XNACK, SRAM-ECC, wave64, and CU mode, occupancy-related VGPR capacity, generic code-object versioning, architecture-family macro name, and generic-compatibility relationship; other generated files and backend logic derive option enums, driver specs, predefined macros, and offload metadata from this single source of truth.
